summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Vagas+ after Apple/Twilio removal. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass covering auth policy, Google session validation, RBAC (candidate cannot create job / access dashboard, recruiter cannot update candidate profile), job CRUD + candidate match scoring, apply flow, chat with 403 for third parties, dashboard totals/stage_totals/jobs, pipeline stage update + candidate notification, video rooms (join OK / wrong code 401 / third-party 403), LGPD consent/export/delete, and AI resume generation via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (gpt-5.4). Frontend: role selection renders both roles, candidate login shows home with match scores, notifications bell opens feed (badge count visible), privacy shield opens LGPD screen with visibility-public/matched_only/private + export-data + delete-account. Recruiter login shows Painel do Anunciante with published jobs, bottom nav (Vagas/Nova/Dashboard/Selo) works, privacy header opens same LGPD screen. No red-screen errors, no ObjectId leakage. Only nit: register endpoint lowercases email (test assertion was updated to reflect canonical email).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1080 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, jobs, chat, video, privacy, ai) for maintainability, though not blocking.
All Mongo queries correctly project out _id; no ObjectId serialization risk observed.
generate_resume() has a JSON fallback path that always returns 200; good UX but may hide LLM formatting drift — consider logging when fallback triggers.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_ prefixed transient users and one TEST job per module run. LGPD test cleans up via DELETE /api/me. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use rec-test1@example.com / cand-test1@example.com with MinhaSenha1! against https://ai-jobs-match-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL before running pytest. Existing recruiter already has 3 published jobs including TEST Dev variants; do not rely on notification counts being empty. Google Auth uses Emergent Managed and cannot be OAuth-completed in CI — verify only the presence/pressability of the google-login button in future UI runs.
rca_of_issue: None — no failures to root cause.
